To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Filipino senior citizens are using social networking sites to connect with family and friends, share information and experiences, and to keep up with current events.

the SCs in our study have a positive attitude towards social media and are willing to share information about themselves online; they are concerned with privacy, especially with regards to the use of personal information by others; and they are concerned with credibility, especially with regards the accuracy of information they receive online.

the senior citizens use social networking sites for the following purposes: 1) to reconnect and communicate with family members and friends; 2) to share their experiences and memories; and 3) to express their opinions and feelings about the world around them.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social networking practices of SCs in the Philippines.
how SCs use their online social network.

the following: (a) how SCs use social media; (b) what their motivations are in using social media; (c) how they manage their online social networks; (d) what their online social networking practices are; and (e) how they view the ethical issues in online social networking.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
senior citizens are not just users of the online social network, they are also producers.

the SCs’ use of online social networks is a positive development for them as it helps them in maintaining and building relationships, and in staying connected with family and friends, especially with their grandchildren.

the SCs are aware of the importance of their privacy, and they are aware of the risks of sharing personal information online, and they do not share their personal information online, but they are not aware of the risks that come with the information they share.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
senior citizens’ social networking is not only for the purpose of connecting with their family and friends but also for the purpose of learning and keeping up to date with current events.
senior citizens are not just passive users of online social networking sites, but they also have their own unique way of using the sites for their own personal purposes.
SCs have the same concerns about their online social networking as the general population, but they are more vulnerable because they have less knowledge and less experience with the technology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the senior citizens’ online social networking is not just a matter of convenience and entertainment.
senior citizens use social networks for socialization, information gathering and dissemination, entertainment, and to stay in touch with family and friends.
senior citizens are using social media in ways that are not only beneficial for themselves, but for others as well.
